title: Charging economics
subtitle: Energy, recorded costs and charging losses for one vehicle and calendar month.
period: Completed sessions, grouped by their start time in {timezone}.
sessionCoverage: {total} sessions · {priced} with valid cost · {missing} missing or invalid costs · {excluded} inconsistent energy pairs excluded
noPrices: No valid recorded prices in this group.
empty: No completed charging sessions in this period.
notRanked: Locations are grouped by saved place, then normalized address. Unlocated sessions remain included. No price ranking: coverage and tariffs can differ.
methodEnergy: Energy totals use every finite, non-negative recorded value; missing values are not zero. Efficiency and loss use only the same sessions with added energy ≥ 0, charger energy > 0 and added energy ≤ charger energy. Efficiency is total paired battery energy divided by total paired charger energy, rather than the average of session percentages. Zero charger energy has no efficiency ratio.
methodPrice: Costs are summed in integer cents within each currency. Missing or malformed currencies remain separate from known currencies and have no comparable unit price. Zero means free; negative, malformed or higher-precision costs are excluded. Each unit price divides only the cost of sessions with a positive value for that energy denominator by their energy. The matched cost, energy and session count are shown for each denominator.
methodSource: Recorded values depend on their source and meter accuracy. Imported or derived battery energy is not an independent charger measurement; sessions without charger energy do not establish charging losses. These figures describe the available records, not a battery health test. Partial cost or energy coverage cannot establish which location is cheaper.
